title: SYNTH-FRAME-1 protocol codec

parent.objective: Bring up a host-side bridge for the fictional SYNTH-SENSOR-1 so that every component is verified independently and no hardware behavior is claimed before it is observed.
parent.milestone: Protocol layer verified against golden vectors

goal: Encode and decode SYNTH-FRAME-1 frames as pure functions and name every invalid-frame cause deterministically.
non_goals: Communicate with, or claim behavior of, any physical device.
Implement transport, timeouts or device sequencing.

prohibited: Edit transport, device, adapter or telemetry modules.
Change the frame layout or golden vectors.

inputs.name: Frame layout
inputs.description: TAG 0xA1, LEN, PAYLOAD[LEN] (LEN <= 16), XOR checksum over TAG..PAYLOAD.

inputs.name: Golden vectors
inputs.description: The valid and invalid vectors embedded in sample/tests/test_codec.py.

outputs.name: Codec module
outputs.description: encode, encode_read_request, decode, decode_reading with no I/O.

outputs.name: Verification record
outputs.description: Automated test outcome for every golden vector.

interface.name: synth_bridge.codec
interface.description: Pure byte-frame functions; decode returns (payload, None) or (None, FrameError).

assumptions: Every vector is synthetic and establishes no real device behavior.

sources.authority: Synthetic specification invented for this example; not a manufacturer document.

sources.reference: examples/software-hardware/sample — the synthetic bridge package and its tests
sources.authority: Reference implementation for this example only; establishes no real device behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: encode then decode returns the original payload for every length 0 through 16.
Every valid golden vector decodes to its specified payload.
Every invalid golden vector returns its specified FrameError code without raising.

architecture_boundaries: Keep the codec free of I/O and of any transport or device knowledge.
Do not change the SYNTH-FRAME-1 frame layout.

hardware_assumptions.assumption: A physical SYNTH-SENSOR-1 frames its replies exactly as SYNTH-FRAME-1 specifies; no device has been observed.
